blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Santiago. A driver will meet you at the airport and take you to your hotel.

Santiago lies beside the Andes. In clear weather, the mountains are visible from the city, beyond its streets, glass towers and residential neighbourhoods. It is a modern business capital with wide avenues, parks, cafés and museums, where old buildings stand alongside high-rises.

In central Chile, January is usually hot and dry, at around 28–32 °C, with almost no rain.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, your city tour begins with an English-speaking guide. You will see La Moneda Palace, which was originally a mint and later became the seat of government. Plaza de Armas is the historic centre, with the cathedral and the former Royal Audiencia.

You will then climb Santa Lucía Hill. From the top, you can see the rooftops and avenues, with the Andes on the horizon when visibility is good. The route then continues through the modern districts of Vitacura, Las Condes and Providencia, past glass towers, hotels, restaurants and business areas, and alongside the Mapocho River.

For an additional fee, you can visit wineries in the Maipo Valley for a Cabernet Sauvignon tasting. Price: **USD 230 per person, minimum 2 people**.
